guard_snippet: place/remove carry plan_version or item id; mismatch -> 409 plan_changed
potential_consequence: A remove deletes the wrong evening after a concurrent change (#123)

trigger_condition: Planned activity dropped at month 60's continue
guard_snippet: show dropped notes on the ending summary or before continue in month 60
potential_consequence: «Ble ikke noe av» has no next month to appear in

trigger_condition: Quit with placed one-off shifts, a pending hours request or an open hours offer
guard_snippet: on quit: remove placed shifts, cancel request and offer, with notes
potential_consequence: Shifts are paid or a request is answered for a job the player no longer has (#123)

trigger_condition: Full-time offer in month 54 to a player with a part-time job
guard_snippet: taking full-time replaces part-time from next month, or refuse with 'quit first'
potential_consequence: One-job rule blocks the full-time offer, or both jobs run

trigger_condition: ±2 h step crosses the limit or floor (11 h at a 12 h limit; 39.5 to 41.5)
guard_snippet: offer = clamp(hours±2, floor, limit); 'no' only if offer==hours
potential_consequence: Undefined: offer above the limit or an unjustified 'no' (#123)

trigger_condition: One-off shift worked in December; shift hours vs free time
guard_snippet: December shift: taxed in the next tax year (state it); shift hours excluded from rule 12 free time
potential_consequence: Tax year and free-time effect of shifts are unspecified (#123, WE 29)

trigger_condition: Steady wage only from summer job or one-off shifts, or wage started last month
guard_snippet: steady_monthly_wage := part/full-time job paid in each of last N months (config)
potential_consequence: Card and loan eligibility differ between implementations (#123 steady-wage window)

trigger_condition: Fixed payment falls below a later minimum, or extra payment exceeds the balance or the accounts
guard_snippet: pay max(fixed, minimum); extra: max=min(balance, current+savings) else refuse
potential_consequence: Fixed mode silently misses the minimum; overpayment creates a credit balance (#123)

trigger_condition: Card-payable monthly cost does not fit under the card limit
guard_snippet: pay() row: card-payable cost not fitting -> accounts per FR-45 order, noted
potential_consequence: Only event purchases have a defined fallback

trigger_condition: 3x average wage minus debt below NOK 5,000 (no loan possible), or quote for out-of-range amount
guard_snippet: if max<5000: loan sheet locked with reason; quote out of range -> 422 with min/max
potential_consequence: Sheet shows an invalid range; quote endpoint behaviour undefined (#123)

trigger_condition: Early payoff of a loan or payment plan with less money than the remaining amount
guard_snippet: if remaining > current+savings: refuse NFR-7 (as in 7.4)
potential_consequence: Payoff overdraws or partially pays; only family-loan payoff is specified

trigger_condition: Loan taken mid-month M
guard_snippet: first instalment in M+1 (FR-12), stated and tested
potential_consequence: First instalment month is unspecified (#123)

trigger_condition: Accounts can cover only part of a family-loan instalment
guard_snippet: pay the covered part, move the rest to the end; or move the whole instalment, stated
potential_consequence: Partial coverage is undefined (#123)

trigger_condition: Player asks family in a regular event and family can't help
guard_snippet: asking is not the real choice; the event stays open for another option
potential_consequence: The real choice is used up with nothing, or the player can't continue

trigger_condition: Trigger true during cooldown, and the band text is chosen
guard_snippet: in cooldown: band says the trigger is true but there is no crisis next month
potential_consequence: «Krise i <måned>» is shown when no crisis will come (#123)

trigger_condition: Skipped crisis month is a non-active (quiet) month
guard_snippet: re-choose only if the month is in active_months, else quiet
potential_consequence: Quiet month gets a drawn event after the skip

trigger_condition: No crisis event fits the urgent trigger and age at runtime
guard_snippet: fallback: next-urgent trigger's events, else generic crisis event; content check reports it
potential_consequence: Crisis month opens with no event, and continue may stay blocked

trigger_condition: Moped sold and a second moped bought later
guard_snippet: parents_share drawn per moped with draw key including the moped seq, or once per playthrough, stated
potential_consequence: Ambiguous redraw lets the player buy again to get a better share

trigger_condition: Player owns a moped and borrows the car in the same month
guard_snippet: transport row: moped and car fuel both charged / car borrow refused while owning a moped
potential_consequence: How transport costs combine is undefined

trigger_condition: «Skjønner» call fails or the device is offline
guard_snippet: on failure: keep note visible, show error, allow retry; never mark seen locally
potential_consequence: Failure path is unspecified; the note may vanish locally but return elsewhere

trigger_condition: Goal 1/2 player pins the experience, which never opens for them
guard_snippet: pinnable = options that can open for this playthrough
potential_consequence: Target shows 'opens in month 44' but never opens

trigger_condition: Tester deletes the account and signs up again with the same address
guard_snippet: testers_left counts distinct codes; on re-sign-up of a counted code, decrement or flag
potential_consequence: A returning tester is counted as having left (#123)
